doc_class_description: A Sri Lanka Cabinet Decision is an official policy or action agreed by the Cabinet of Ministers, shaping governance, law, and national development in the country.

latest_doc_d.description: Amending the Inland Revenue Act, No.24 of 2017
latest_doc_d.decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
latest_doc_d.decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-05-19 to introduce amendments to the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017, incorporating the proposed tax reforms, in order to enhance the tax system while paving way for the revenue-based fiscal consolidation. Accordingly, the amending Bill has been prepared by the Legal Draftsman and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the same. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
